statusReason: Sub-phase 9.4.6 replaced the vacuous text-Jaccard gold matcher with evidence-turn intersection and fixed the LoCoMo D<day>:<turn> loader miss. All metrics below are measured against the full 10-conversation LoCoMo corpus (1986 QA items) with a warm live-extraction cache (google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it). n_scored ~ 71-73% of QAs on each sweep; n_skipped accounts for QAs whose retrieval produced no entry intersecting gold evidence.
knownIssues: Ladder retriever underperforms both bm25only and random on LoCoMo by orders of magnitude — see structuralInvariants.ladderVsBm25Only and ladderVsRandom. The scorer chain appears to actively demote correct results past rank 10 for most queries. Recall@10 on the ladder is 0.6074 vs 1.0000 for bm25only/recency/random, indicating the ladder keeps the gold entry inside its retrieval window but ranks it poorly. Not a 9.4.6 scope; defer to sub-phase 9.4.7 or Phase 11 for structural diagnosis.
Tier 3 (graph) contributes 0.0001 MRR lift over Tier-2-only baseline at best elbow — well below the 0.05 threshold. Graph sweep flags structural-bug on every round. Deferred for same reason as above.

Tuning recommendations below are local elbows on a structurally-broken retrieval surface — treat as advisory, not authoritative. Ladder MRR range across all 48 tau points is 0.1108 - 0.1136 (delta 0.0028); this is noise-level compared to bm25only's 0.6909.

Baseline sweeps used small synthetic corpora before Phase 9; full-LoCoMo numbers here supersede all 2026-04-21 sweep artifacts (preserved in-tree as 2026-04-21-*.md with -rulebased-prefix / -VACUOUS-pre-9-4-6 rename for provenance).

TIER2_TAU_CONFIDENCE.note: Advisory. MRR range 0.1108-0.1136 across 48 points; elbow falls at lowest knob value. Ladder structurally broken on this corpus; elbow is noise-level.

TIER2_TAU_GAP.note: Advisory. Same flat surface as TIER2_TAU_CONFIDENCE.

TIER3_LAMBDA_1.note: Advisory. Graph tier adds 0.0001 MRR over Tier-2-only baseline; structural-bug flag fired on all 5 rounds (lift < 0.05).

TIER3_BEAM_WIDTH.note: Advisory. No clear elbow; fallback to highest MRR = 0.1119.

EDGE_CAP_PER_ENTRY.note: Advisory. MRR lift 0.0003 at best. Spec default happens to coincide with elbow.

DEDUP_JACCARD_THRESHOLD.note: Advisory. updateRate ranges 4.4% -> 0.7% across thresholds (knob is doing real work on consolidation internals) but retrieval quality is flat (recall@5 and MRR constant to 4 decimals). Dedup affects storage, not retrieval on this corpus.

TAG_BOOST.note: Advisory. Flat heatmap (max-min < 0.01 across 16 cells); no clear elbow; fallback to highest MRR = 0.1126. Tags populated rate 100% confirms mechanism fires, but ladder score chain doesn't surface the signal.

headlineMetrics.skipReasonNote: Skipped QAs are those where no retrieved entry's provenance.sourceMessages intersected qa.evidenceTurns. Reflects retrieval misses, not corpus gaps (99.5% of LoCoMo QAs have non-empty evidenceTurns after the 9.4.6 Task 2 loader fix).

ladderVsRandom.note: Ladder MRR (0.1118) is 0.19 BELOW random (0.3028). Retrieval pipeline actively demotes gold below random selection. Defer to Phase 11 / sub-phase 9.4.7 for structural diagnosis.

ladderVsBm25Only.note: Ladder MRR (0.1118) is 0.58 BELOW bm25only (0.6909). The same content that bm25only ranks at MRR 0.69 ends up at MRR 0.11 through the ladder. Scorer chain is catastrophically broken on LoCoMo.
